fullDescription: A high-end, futuristic dark-mode admin customization interface featuring 'Dark Neumorphism' aesthetics. Characterized by deep navy and obsidian tones (#050509, #0d0d1a), vibrant violet-to-pink gradients (#7c3aed to #db2777), and advanced spring-physics animations. This design system is optimized for SaaS configuration panels, developer tools, and fintech dashboards. Key features include staggered cascade reveals, floating label inputs with validation states, elastic accordion transitions, and glassmorphic sticky headers. The layout utilizes a bento-grid inspired stats section and a persistent, high-contrast action bar for global state management.

structured.summary: A premium dark-themed customization dashboard with a 'Configuration Engine' aesthetic, utilizing neumorphic depth, spring-based micro-interactions, and high-contrast typography hierarchy.

style.description: The style blends 'Dark Neumorphism' with high-tech accents. Typography pairs 'General Sans' for headlines with 'Satoshi' for body text, emphasizing uppercase tracking (0.2em-0.4em) for a technical feel. The color palette is strictly deep: Backgrounds are #050509 and #0d0d1a, while interactive elements use a purple-to-pink gradient (#7c3aed to #db2777). Shadow work is critical, using both flat outward shadows for cards and inset shadows for inputs to create 3D depth. Animations must use a custom spring easing (cubic-bezier 0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for a tactile, elastic feel.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using a dark neumorphic theme. 

### Colors
- Core Background: #050509
- Panel Background: #0d0d1a
- Card Surface: #121225
- Primary Accent: #7c3aed (Purple)
- Secondary Accent: #db2777 (Pink)
- Muted Text: #94a3b8
- Success State: #10b981

### Shadows (The 'Neumorphic' Recipe)
- Flat Card Shadow: 6px 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)
- Inset Shadow (Inputs): inset 4px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)

### Typography
- Headlines: 'General Sans', weight 600, size 3rem+ for page titles.
- Technical Labels: Uppercase, tracking 0.3em, font-weight 800, size 10px-12px.
- Body Text: 'Satoshi', weight 400-500, #e2e8f0.

### Motion
- Transition Curve: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for all scales and transforms.
- Cascade Delay: 100ms staggering for entering elements.

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed-sidebar layout with a persistent glassmorphism header and a scrollable content area that terminates in a sticky global action footer.

prompts.prompt: Fixed 256px width sidebar. Background #0a0a18 with a 1px border-right (white/5%). Navigation items should have 12px vertical padding, 10px uppercase bold text with 0.15em tracking. Active state: purple left-to-right gradient background (opacity 10%) and a 3px solid #7c3aed right border. Include a bottom user profile card with a 36px gradient avatar.

80px height header with backdrop-blur-xl and background #050509/80. Left side: Breadcrumb using uppercase 10px bold text separated by chevrons. Middle: Search bar with inset shadow (nm-dark-inset), 256px wide expanding to 320px on focus. Right side: Icon buttons with hover scale (1.1) and rotation (12deg) effects.

Three-column grid layout. Each card is a neumorphic container (nm-dark-flat) with 24px padding and rounded-3xl (approx 24px-32px). Include a status indicator: one card with a circular progress ring (border-t-purple-500) and another with a pulsing emerald dot (pulse-glow animation).

Stacked cards with rounded-[2.5rem]. Header contains a 64px icon box with 10% opacity colored background and a large 4xl icon. Content expansion uses grid-template-rows transition (0fr to 1fr) for smooth height adjustment. Active accordion state should show a subtle purple glow and a 180-degree rotated chevron.

Positioned at bottom: 0, z-index 20. Features a thin gradient divider line. The main container is a neumorphic card with backdrop-blur-md, housing a 'Save' button. The button must be a full-width gradient (purple-to-indigo), 20px padding, with text tracking at 0.4em.

special_ui_components.description: An input field where the label transitions from a placeholder to a tiny top-aligned badge on focus.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a relative container for inputs. Input field: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), border 1px solid white/5%, rounded-2xl. Label: absolute, top 1.1rem, left 1.5rem, transition using cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1). On focus/not-empty: translate to top -0.6rem, scale down to 0.65rem, change color to #7c3aed, add background #0d0d1a to label text to mask input border.

special_ui_components.description: Tactile toggle switch with glow and scale animations.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: 44px x 24px, background #2d2d4a, rounded-full, inset shadow. Thumb: 18px circle, white. When checked: background changes to purple-pink gradient, box-shadow 0 0 15px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4). Thumb moves 20px right and scales to 1.1x using spring-easing (0.4s duration).

special_ui_components.description: Button with three visual states: default, loading, and success.
special_ui_components.prompt: Default: Purple gradient, 'SAVE_CONFIGURATION' text. Loading: Replace text with 'SYNCING_DATA...', show rotating loader icon. Success: Green-tinted gradient, 'SUCCESSFUL_SYNC' text, show checkmark icon. Transitions between states must be 300ms fades with scale adjustments (0.98x click effect).
